summary: Phase 4 features (Beds, Schedule, Bulk Import) tested end-to-end. All 8 pytest backend tests pass. Playwright UI flows for Schedule CRUD + public portal propagation, Bed generation/labeling/assignment + assignment-row bed_label display, and Bulk import (teams table refresh + participants dialog open) all pass. Test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: imports.py: `_read_rows` reads entire file into memory - fine for MVP but consider streaming for large XLSX.
accommodation.py: `generate_beds` loops per bed instead of bulk-insert - trivial perf smell for high room capacities.
schedule.py `_dict` runs an extra DB fetch per event for team/venue; could use joinedload for a listing endpoint - not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Temp CSV /tmp/test_import_teams.csv (harmless). All created teams/events/assignments/beds cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_phase4_features.py verifies beds CRUD/generate, bed-based assignments (400 for wrong room, 409 for double booking, bed_label surfaced in list), schedule CRUD + team-linked events surfacing under /api/public/teams/{id}.schedule, and CSV bulk imports for teams (dup skip, missing-name error) and participants (unknown-team error). Participants listing endpoint is /api/participants?team_id={id} (not /api/teams/{id}/participants).
